title: Synthesis and in silico insights of some tetrahydrobenzothienopyrimidine candidates as multi-target antimicrobial, antiproliferative, and antiviral agents
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,26909-26927
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01842D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Amna S. Elgubbi, Selwan Hamed, Budur Nuwayji Alanazi, Hoda A. Ahmed, Sayed K. Ramadan
Fused tri- and tetracyclic tetrahydrobenzo[b]thiophenes were prepared. Tetracyclic derivatives showed potent antibacterial, antifungal, and antiviral activity; cyanomethyl was most active vs. HAdV-7 and SARS-CoV-2, followed by thiazolidinone.
